title: Detailed wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='faceGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8f4ff'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#b8d8f0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8bbde0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bandGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8B6914'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#D4A854'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8B6914'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='caseGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#E8C870'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#C4982A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#A07820'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Band top -->
  <path d='M38,8 Q39,4 42,3 L58,3 Q61,4 62,8 L62,22 L38,22 Z' fill='url(#bandGrad)'/>
  <!-- Band bottom -->
  <path d='M38,78 L38,92 Q39,96 42,97 L58,97 Q61,96 62,92 L62,78 Z' fill='url(#bandGrad)'/>
  <!-- Band stitching top -->
  <line x1='41' y1='5' x2='59' y2='5' stroke='#A07820' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='41' y1='10' x2='59' y2='10' stroke='#A07820' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <line x1='41' y1='15' x2='59' y2='15' stroke='#A07820' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <!-- Band stitching bottom -->
  <line x1='41' y1='82' x2='59' y2='82' stroke='#A07820' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <line x1='41' y1='87' x2='59' y2='87' stroke='#A07820' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <line x1='41' y1='92' x2='59' y2='92' stroke='#A07820' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Watch case outer -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='30' fill='url(#caseGrad)'/>
  <!-- Bezel inner ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='26' fill='#B8860B' stroke='#E8C870' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Watch face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='22' fill='url(#faceGlow)'/>

  <!-- Hour markers -->
  <g stroke='#2A5590' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='50' y1='29' x2='50' y2='34'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='66' x2='50' y2='71'/>
    <line x1='29' y1='50' x2='34' y2='50'/>
    <line x1='66' y1='50' x2='71' y2='50'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small hour dots -->
  <g fill='#2A5590'>
    <circle cx='57.5' cy='32.5' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='64.5' cy='40.5' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='67.5' cy='50' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='64.5' cy='59.5' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='57.5' cy='67.5' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='42.5' cy='67.5' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='35.5' cy='59.5' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='32.5' cy='50' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='35.5' cy='40.5' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='42.5' cy='32.5' r='0.8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Subdial small seconds at 6 o'clock position -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='5' fill='#d0e8f8' stroke='#2A5590' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <g stroke='#2A5590' stroke-width='0.5'>
    <line x1='50' y1='55.5' x2='50' y2='57'/>
    <line x1='54.5' y1='60' x2='53' y2='60'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='64.5' x2='50' y2='63'/>
    <line x1='45.5' y1='60' x2='47' y2='60'/>
  </g>
  <line x1='50' y1='60' x2='52.5' y2='58.5' stroke='#c0392b' stroke-width='0.7'/>

  <!-- Hands -->
  <!-- Hour hand pointing to ~10 -->
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='40' y2='38' stroke='#1a3a6a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Minute hand pointing to ~2 -->
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='63' y2='36' stroke='#1a3a6a' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Second hand -->
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='48' y2='32' stroke='#E04030' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='1.8' fill='#E04030'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='0.8' fill='#FFD700'/>

  <!-- Crown on right side -->
  <rect x='79' y='47' width='4' height='6' rx='1' fill='#C4982A' stroke='#E8C870' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <rect x='80' y='48' width='2' height='4' rx='0.5' fill='#A07820'/>

  <!-- Lug highlights -->
  <rect x='40' y='20' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#E8C870'/>
  <rect x='56' y='20' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#E8C870'/>
  <rect x='40' y='77' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#E8C870'/>
  <rect x='56' y='77' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#E8C870'/>

  <!-- Glass reflection -->
  <path d='M36,40 Q38,34 44,31' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
